about: Ideas looked at on index data before (or instead of) becoming setups. They count as ideas tried in the search's pass bar (ADR-0005), so a quick look at many versions cannot sneak a lucky one through. One line per idea; never delete.

ideas.what: gap-down, big red first 5-min candle, call at 09:20
ideas.result: Nifty 35% / Bank Nifty 50% target first (+0.4% before -0.3%); became setup gap_down_call_920 (yardstick of the idea)

ideas.what: same, plus the 09:20 candle closes green, call at 09:25
ideas.result: Nifty 3 of 16, Bank Nifty 8 of 15: dropped

ideas.what: same, plus the 09:20 candle makes a new low and closes in its top 40%, call at 09:25
ideas.result: Nifty 0 of 5, Bank Nifty 2 of 8: dropped

ideas.what: same, plus back above the first candle's close by 09:30, call
ideas.result: Nifty 5 of 14, Bank Nifty 11 of 16; became setup gap_down_reversal

ideas.what: 5 EMA video, selling side: 5-min alert above the EMA, break of its low, stop alert high, 1:3, max 3 a day (alert lasts one candle)
ideas.result: Nifty 3,202 trades: target 24.6% / SL 70.9%, +0.06R, +1.3 pts; Bank Nifty +0.02R, +1.9 pts (before option costs); became setup ema5_sell_5m

ideas.what: same, alert stays until a candle closes below the EMA
ideas.result: same as the one-candle rule (+0.06R / +0.03R): dropped

ideas.what: 5 EMA video, buying side: 15-min alert below the EMA, break of its high, stop alert low, 1:3, max 3 a day
ideas.result: target 15% / SL 61-63%, -0.01R both indices; became setup ema5_buy_15m

ideas.what: both sides with the video's minimum stop (about Rs 30-40 on the option = 70 index points)
ideas.result: Nifty sell +0.05R (target 6%, mostly flat at close), buy -0.02R; Bank Nifty +0.02R / -0.01R: dropped

ideas.what: 10 EMA video: 5-min opposite-colour candle off the EMA, break entry, stop = EMA, 1:2, both directions
ideas.result: Nifty won 39.6% / 39.7% (long / short), +0.09R, +2.7 / +2.2 pts; Bank Nifty +0.02 / +0.03R, +3.3 / +2.7 pts (before option costs); became setup ema10_trend_5m

ideas.what: same, after 1:2 hold and exit on a 5-min close through the EMA
ideas.result: Nifty +0.12R (+3.6 / +2.4 pts), Bank Nifty +0.05R (+5.1 / +4.2 pts): small gain, not built yet
